'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Ryan French DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan French]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet title I Don't Know My Name. Oppressive Enforcement struck on shields; omitted.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ryan French]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / Your Fantasy Made Real|Carbon Chamber Testing]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
